description: Pakistan Services Limited is principally engaged in the hotel business and owns and operates the Pearl Continental Hotels chain in Pakistan. It manages six luxury hotels - at Karachi, Lahore, Rawalpindi, Bhurban, Malam Jabba and Muzaffarabad - comprising 1,445 rooms, with its registered office in Islamabad.
headOffice: 1st Floor, NESPAK House, G-5/2, Islamabad, Pakistan
